g.text: Verification Workflow: HSTS Missing From HTTPS Server (RFC 6797)
Description: Confirm whether HTTPS responses carry a Strict-Transport-Security header with an
│ Check the HTTPS response for a Strict-Transport-Security header
│ Notes: No output = no HSTS header = confirmed. Also flag a header with max-age below 31536000 (1
│ A header present with max-age >= 31536000 = false positive. Use a GET (as above) rather than -I,
│ only add HSTS to GET responses. Check every HTTPS port Nessus listed - CDN alternate ports
│ (2053/2083/2087/2096/8443) can behave differently from 443. An error or 404 response without HSTS
│ browsers honour HSTS on any response sent over HTTPS. Reached from a nuclei finding:
│ fires on several headers at once, so read its matcher names first - this workflow only settles the
│ strict-transport-security one, and a matcher naming a different header is a separate finding.
